mitres.name: Unsecured Credentials: Bash History
mitres.description: Lecture du fichier .bash_history pour extraire des commandes contenant des credentials en clair.

cat ~/.bash_history 2>/dev/null || echo.stdout:
apt update && apt upgrade -y
systemctl status nginx
systemctl status mysql
docker ps -a
docker compose -f /opt/app/docker-compose.yml up -d
tail -f /var/log/nginx/access.log
cd /var/www/app && git pull origin main
python3 manage.py migrate
systemctl restart gunicorn
mysql -u root -p
cat /etc/passwd
ssh devops@10.0.1.10
crontab -l

cat /root/.bash_history 2>/dev/null || e.stdout:

cd /var/www/app && git pull origin main
python3 manage.py migrate
systemctl restart gunicorn
mysql -u root -p
cat /etc/passwd
ssh devops@10.0.1.10
crontab -l
